status: declared before DINOv2 clustering; pilot = explored development set; dev partition = development only; held-out never touched

backbones.dinov2_{s,b,l}: official LVD-142M checkpoints via timm, pinned revisions in reports/dinov2/models.json; CLS token, final LayerNorm; layers -1,-2,-4; 224 px for S/B/L, 518 px (timm default) for S/B

representation_rule: identical to results/phase2/source/benchmark.py transform(): L2 / global mean-centering then L2 / full-SVD non-whitened PCA then L2; fitted on the clustered rows only, no labels

methods.hdbscan: min_cluster_size 20, noise scored as its own cluster (primary) and assigned-only

k_note: fixed predeclared anchor; no k selection by labels
primary_comparison: centered_l2, k=10, HS3 AMI and ARI, mean over seeds; three backbones at their default configs: CLIP, SigLIP, DINOv2-B 518 px layer -1
rq3: model size S/B/L and layer -1/-2/-4 at 224 px; resolution 224 vs 518 for S/B; k-means/agglomerative/spectral, centered_l2, k=10

linear_probe.labels: HS3 classes with >= 10 labelled pilot images (13 classes)
linear_probe.protocol: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, seed 0): train on 4 folds, predict the held-out fold; out-of-fold accuracy, balanced accuracy, AMI
linear_probe.separation: supervised reference only, reported in a separate table; never used to build or select clusters

dev_partition: reports/full_dataset/benchmark/dev_ids.csv (12,000 rows); CLIP, SigLIP and DINOv2-B (224 px) embedded with the same adaptation; same methods at k=10 and at k=13 (benchmark HS3 class count, label-informed reference only, flagged)
heldout: reports/full_dataset/benchmark/heldout_ids_DO_NOT_USE_FOR_SELECTION.csv is not embedded, clustered or scored
